answer: Persistent work-history collateral: each identity earns standing only through verified task traces, and reputation payouts unlock along a dune of accumulated history. Cloning forces a new identity to repeat that ramp from zero, while honest agents compound returns at every vertex of their record. Withdrawal of earned balance requires a grove of corroborating peer receipts, so a Sybil cluster must fund redundant work and cross-confirmation before its clones become economically useful.
